name: SoSoValue
steps: 1 Step 1 : Open the SSI rewards site Go to the SSI reward page and read the Epoch 5 details, which show the 21 May to 17 November 2026 schedule and the 15,000,000 SOSO pool.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Use the Connect Wallet button on the SSI site so your holdings and points are tied to one wallet.
3 Step 3 : Get an SSI token Buy one of the SSI index tokens through the SSI site. Points are only counted for SSI tokens you hold, stake or lock.

4 Step 4 : Hold or stake your SSI Keep the tokens in your wallet, stake them on the rewards page, or lock them in a Uni LP position. Your daily share of the 100,000,000 points depends on how much you hold and stake compared with other users.
5 Step 5 : Optionally stake SOSO for a boost Staking SOSO beside your SSI tokens increases your loyalty points. A boost of at least 1% is required to take part in it.
6 Step 6 : Wait for the distribution Rewards are paid after Epoch 5 ends, following SoSoValue's final announcement. The EXP page separately lists Season 3 activity.
what: The SoSoValue airdrop is a 15,000,000 SOSO reward pool for people who hold or stake SoSoValue Indexes (SSI) tokens during Staking Epoch 5, which runs until 17 November 2026.
